wake.description: a promise to come back to something at a time

at.description: when it is next due; absent once a one-shot has fired and a recurrence has ended

target.description: what the wake is about — the entity carrying it when absent

note.description: a line for whoever is woken: why you asked to be

every.description: how it recurs: a duration (30m, 2h, 1d), a cron line (0 9 * * 1-5), or @daily

fired.description: when a wake last went off
